description: Source code for OSDP command processing in Zephyr OS, including command building, decoding, state management, and communication handling.

methods.name: cp_cmd_alloc
methods.description: Allocates memory for a new osdp_cmd structure from a memory slab.

methods.name: cp_cmd_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for an osdp_cmd structure back to the slab.

methods.name: cp_cmd_enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a command into the command queue of a given osdp_pd.

methods.name: cp_cmd_dequeue
methods.description: Dequeues a command from the command queue of a given osdp_pd.

methods.name: osdp_extract_address
methods.description: Parses a list of addresses from configuration and fills the address array.

methods.name: cp_build_command
methods.description: Constructs a command packet based on the current command ID and data.

methods.name: cp_decode_response
methods.description: Decodes a response buffer from a PD and updates the PD state accordingly.

methods.name: cp_build_packet
methods.description: Builds a complete packet including header, command, and footer.

methods.name: cp_send_command
methods.description: Sends the constructed command packet over the communication channel.

methods.name: cp_process_reply
methods.description: Processes incoming reply data from the PD.

methods.name: cp_flush_command_queue
methods.description: Clears all pending commands from the command queue.

methods.name: cp_set_state
methods.description: Sets the current state of the PD communication state machine.

methods.name: cp_set_online
methods.description: Sets the PD state to online and resets relevant timers.

methods.name: cp_set_offline
methods.description: Sets the PD state to offline and manages retries.

methods.name: cp_sc_should_retry
methods.description: Determines if SC handshake should be retried based on timing.

methods.name: cp_phy_state_update
methods.description: Updates the physical layer state machine, handling command sending and reply processing.

methods.name: cp_cmd_dispatcher
methods.description: Dispatches commands to the PD, managing command queue and response flags.

methods.name: state_update
methods.description: Main state machine for managing PD connection, initialization, and security handshake.

methods.name: osdp_update
methods.description: Updates all connected PDs by running their state machines.

methods.name: osdp_setup
methods.description: Initializes the OSDP context with optional master key.

methods.name: osdp_cp_set_event_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback for OSDP events.

methods.name: osdp_cp_send_command
methods.description: Queues a command to be sent to a specific PD.
